clinical_boundary.included: Guidance that can affect assessment, diagnosis, biopsy, referral, initial local management, or surveillance of a suspicious cutaneous lesion represented by the dermatology study labels.
excluded: advanced systemic oncology regimens and drug dosing
health-technology appraisals not used for lesion assessment or initial local management
prevention-only public-health material without a patient-level lesion decision
procedure-only or reconstruction guidance that starts after the in-scope lesion decision and does not govern assessment, diagnosis, biopsy, referral, or initial lesion treatment
superseded documents except as metadata-linked history

label_mapping.note: AKIEC is not treated as actinic keratosis alone; the scope must cover both actinic keratosis and intraepithelial carcinoma/Bowen disease. SCC is retained for external/actionable evaluation even though it is outside the shared HAM7 denominator.

issuer_policy.inventory_rule: Enumerate every current English-language document returned by each prespecified issuer inventory that intersects the clinical boundary; apply exclusions before viewing retrieval results.

excluded_inventory_classes.reason: Outside the frozen patient-level lesion decision boundary.
Procedure-wide or post-resection guidance that does not govern the in-scope lesion decision.
Conditions are not represented by the frozen study labels.

content_policy.inventory_metadata: Store identifiers, titles, dates, status, mappings, canonical links, and licensing evidence for all in-scope documents.
content_policy.machine_indexing: Index recommendation-level text only when the source license or written permission explicitly permits the intended research machine-processing use. Free access is not assumed to grant reuse rights.
content_policy.abstracts: Abstracts may support discovery and internal research retrieval, but they are not recommendation-level coverage and cannot by themselves make the comprehensive-guideline-retrieval claim true.
content_policy.permission_gated_documents: Remain link-and-metadata-only until permission or a qualifying reusable edition is receipt-bound.
content_policy.provenance_semantics: Source identity and lineage do not establish clinical truth.

claim_policy.supported_now: A comprehensive, versioned inventory of current in-scope documents from the prespecified issuer inventories as of 2026-07-17, with explicit machine-indexing and licensing status.
claim_policy.supported_after_full_coverage: Comprehensive, versioned retrieval over all current in-scope recommendation text that was legally permitted for machine indexing as of 2026-07-17.
claim_policy.fallback_if_permissions_remain_blocked: Comprehensive guideline inventory with retrieval over the licensed/open-access subset.
prohibited: full guideline coverage based on abstracts alone

inventory: all primary issuer inventories checked at the cutoff date
every included document has a current/superseded status and canonical identifier
every document maps to at least one in-scope condition and question type
all exclusions have a recorded reason
corpus: every required current document is either recommendation-level indexed or explicitly permission-blocked
each indexed chunk has document/version/section/recommendation lineage and a content hash
license or permission evidence is receipt-bound
no abstract is counted as recommendation-level text
benchmark: queries cover every condition-question cell with at least one applicable current document
gold evidence is recommendation-level and independently checked
primary metrics include Recall@k, nDCG@k, MRR, citation precision/recall, and source/version accuracy
results are stratified by condition, question type, issuer, and permission coverage
